scope: Six real object meshes, two horizontal yaws per object. Hand-only independent simulation; no arm or paper success-rate reproduction.
asset_selection: Existing public meshes preferred, freeze IDs/SHA/units/collision parts before rendering. Retain original geometry in metres, no size tuning to force success.
poses: Each object normal tabletop resting orientation, minimum surface at z0; fixed world XY [0,.08], yaws0/90; no placement search or inverted bowl unless explicitly declared.
input: Actual partial RGB-D/color/calibration only. No object class, geometry or true pose provided to network.

inference.candidate_selection: Original argsort final top1 after original collision

reporting: All12 scenes remain in denominator; no-candidate, stage failure, observed lift and numerical validity separate. Save all attempted grasp videos including failures. No parameter/timestep/object/pose retuning based on outcomes.
geometry: Visual original triangle surfaces; dynamic compound convex parts preserving object hollow regions when relevant. Record approximation and actual engine shape. Do not silently replace cup/bowl by one filled convex hull.
cost: Network/model/asset/preprocess/render/physics/media times separately. Cohort driver measures pipeline-to-last-worker wall, all actual steps, no hidden substeps.
regression: Reuse existing passed cube and primitive evidence; no need to re-execute unchanged controller. Minimal runner change only allows new mesh_scene module.
